name: ESL MPSoC tile array with shared memory hierarchy
author: cp-4895 (WP-6, ADR-0005 D3 §1b row) -- extends the esl-mpsoc-tile-array \foreach generator layer (cp-4892, WP-4) with the contract's mem-block component
description: Parametric MPSoC tile row (\ntiles), each containing a \pespertile-wide PE sub-row (containment, solid intrabus), sharing one mem-block pinned on a fixed row above the tile grid and reached by every tile's dashed interbus edge (pinned-axis primitive). Closes the contract §1b mem-block gap left open by esl-architecture-block/esl-mpsoc-tile-array. Colors reuse the ESL domain-semantic scheme (core-accent=PE, intra-bus=Orange, inter-bus=NavyBlue dashed, digitaldomain=shared memory).

parameters.name: \ntiles
parameters.meaning: number of tiles in the row

parameters.name: \tilegap
parameters.meaning: horizontal gap between tile boundary boxes

parameters.name: \pegap
parameters.meaning: gap between PEs within a tile

parameters.name: \memheight
parameters.meaning: vertical offset of the shared mem-block above the tile row

parameters.name: \memlabel
parameters.meaning: shared mem-block label (use \\ for two lines)

edit_contract.node_naming: tile: tile-<t> (generated, index-addressable); pe: pe-<t>-<k> (generated, index-addressable); mem-block: (mem)

operations.summary: edit \ntiles and/or \pespertile -- the generator re-derives every node name and position; no coordinate ever needs hand-editing
\pesize/\pegap for PE sizing and intra-tile density; \tilegap for inter-tile density; \memheight to raise/lower the pinned mem-block row
edit \memlabel to rename the shared memory block (e.g. "L1$/$L2", "DRAM")

change the domain-semantic color for a whole role (pe/tilebox/memblock/intrabus/interbus) in that role's style definition; keep the family assignments (core-accent=PE, digitaldomain=mem-block, intra-bus=Orange, inter-bus=NavyBlue-dashed) unless a family settled-decisions record overrides it

invariants: a template must not name a semantic component the contract's §1 vocabulary does not define (§1 extensibility rule)
style/color bindings carry their contract §2 token role; a role's color is never swapped for decoration

hierarchy-is-organizer: explicit HIERARCHY/containment is the organizing primitive — tile ⊃ (pe | cpu-core | acc-core | mem-block); state the nesting explicitly so it is checkable and transfers to a nested-graph backend (ELK subgraphs, draw.io containers).
tiles-on-a-grid: tile containers are laid out on a regular grid (rows x columns), uniform size and gap; the grid is anchored once and every other tile placed relationally off it.
pes-inside-tiles: pe (and cpu-core / acc-core) nodes sit INSIDE their tile via the tile's fit/opts; a PE never floats outside the tile it belongs to.

tile-fit-declared-after-members: a tile's boundary fit node is declared AFTER every node it fits, inside an `on background layer` scope, so the tile box renders behind its members rather than occluding them.

ports-on-boundaries: buses attach at PORTS pinned on the tile/block BOUNDARY at the connection point; an inter-bus/NoC edge attaches to a tile's boundary port, never to a PE interior, and routes orthogonally from there.
intra-bus-stays-in-tile: intra-bus edges are SHORT and orthogonal, connecting PEs/mem within ONE tile only; they never cross a tile boundary.
noc-spine-between-tiles: the NoC / inter-bus is routed ORTHOGONALLY along the gaps between tile edges (a spine/mesh between tiles), connecting tile boundary ports, not PE interiors.
shared-memory-locus: shared-memory (mem-block) sits at ONE consistent locus across the set (e.g. a central spine or a fixed edge), the same place in every figure of the family.
legend-corner-groupbox: the legend is a group-box in a fixed corner, outside the tile grid; it never overlaps tiles or the NoC spine.
bus-color-split: intra-bus = Orange, inter-bus/NoC = NavyBlue (contract §2 tokens); consistent.

bus-dash-split: the inter-tile bus is ALWAYS dashed and the intra-tile bus is ALWAYS solid — this distinction is load-bearing (NoC/global vs. local/tile-internal traffic), independent of and in addition to the color split above.
core-accents: cpu-core = Aquamarine fill, acc-core = ForestGreen fill; PEs a light green.

palette-additive-not-remapped: the ESL domain-semantic tokens (core-accent/process-accent/param-accent/ intra-bus/inter-bus) are ADDITIVE to opentikz's five ot* names — never remapped onto or aliased through otblue/otorange/otteal/otpurple/otgray.
containment-is-membership: a node drawn inside a tile IS a member of that tile; no purely decorative nesting.
